## Project Summary

Application successfully created for analyzing Excel order data with weekly and monthly groupings.

### Structure
- `/src/app` - Next.js app router pages
- `/src/components` - React components (FileUploader, OrderAnalyzer)
- `/src/types` - TypeScript type definitions
- `/src/utils` - Utility functions for data processing

### Key Features
- Excel file upload and parsing
- Weekly grouping (Monday-Sunday)
- Monthly grouping with subtotals
- Expandable detail views
- Automatic calculation of orders and deliveries totals
